resources.string: Which alarms should set your wake-up time?
Recommended. Uses Google Clock or Samsung Clock.
Every profile uses its own wake time.
Alarms from apps you haven’t ticked, such as calendars and reminders, are never used.
Choose exactly which apps below can set your wake-up.
Tick a white-noise, sleep or other alarm app to use its alarms too. Only alarms Android shows on your lock screen can be followed; some apps keep theirs private.
None seen yet. Set an alarm in the app, then open this list again, or show more apps.
No other apps that set alarms were found.
Has set an alarm on this phone
Asks to set alarms. Nocturne can only use its alarms if they show on your lock screen.

Use a fixed wake time for %1$s
Android sometimes reports an alarm without saying which app set it. A calendar reminder can look like this too.
Recommended. Tonight offers the alarm, and nothing changes until you tap it.
Used like an alarm from a ticked app, if it’s 1 to 18 hours after the night starts.
A calendar reminder or another app’s alarm could then change your wake time, or when Auto-start begins a night. Only alarms 1 to 18 hours after the night starts are used.
